title: Identity-stage equation for normalized finite Verdier comparisons
statement: theorem finite_unit_equation (F : Finite D l hl Ω X) : ∀ (E : Index l Ω) (K : Stage l Ω X E), (F.beta E E le_rfl).hom.app (op K) = (unitor l Ω X E).hom.app ((F.datum E).dual.obj (op K)) ≫ (F.datum E).dual.map ((unitor l Ω X E).hom.app K).op

proof.text: Apply the normalized rational Verdier unit/composition theorem to the finite scalar comparisons, identify coefficient inclusion identities/composites, and transport the canonical integral normalization to the recorded stage unitor/associator.
